messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick heads-up — landed a small pricing page experiment for EU with a micro-FAQ variant and a simplified monthly/year toggle. Wanted to flag for growth and content review. Link: https://redwood.com/pricing-experiment
Ethan (Growth): Nice. Which metric are we watching? signups or trial->paid?
Maya (Marketing): Primary: signups from /pricing -> signup flow. Secondary: time-on-page and CTA clicks. Also watch CS tickets.
Priya (Content): Can I see the FAQ copy? I swapped the 'commitment' language to 'reserved capacity' but want to avoid legal-y phrasing.
Maya (Marketing): Pasted below:
```
FAQ snippet: Q: What's 'Committed' mean? A: Reserved capacity with discount for monthly/annual commitments. Cancel anytime after term.
```
Jamie (Product): Re: metric - add # of requests to contact-sales (for enterprise routing). Also, is calculator still on the lower right? Last time it hurt mobile.
Maya (Marketing): Yes calc is present but we hide on narrow view. AB test: variant A = calculator visible; variant B = condensed estimator modal triggered by CTA.
Sam (Sales): Heads up — if variant A increases enterprise leads, we need lead routing logic to pass bundle size. Can we include hidden field in calculator with 'est. vCPU' to help triage?
Priya (Content): Small copy tweak suggestion: change 'Cancel anytime' -> 'Flexible end-of-term options' (less churn connotation).
Maya (Marketing): Thanks. Ethan, can you spin up GA events? event names: pricing_view, pricing_calc_open, pricing_estimate_submit, pricing_contact_sales. Also create funnel seg for 'paid commit within 30d'.
Ethan (Growth): On it. Will also tag by country (EU/US) and device. ETA EOD.
deploybot (QA Bot): design variant B live on staging at 2024-06-14 15:22 UTC :white_check_mark:
Maya (Marketing): Quick note for benchmarks narrative — suggest we call this experiment 'SlimEstimator' in comms to keep it short.
Sam (Sales): Fine but keep ops aware so we can capture 'estimated commit' on inbound form.
Maya (Marketing): I'll add to the launch post draft. Short announcement planned for next Wed webinar: 'Price clarity: how we optimize for predictability'. Will loop comms.
Priya (Content): Draft headline for the post: 'Simpler pricing, clearer commitments — try our new estimator'.
Ethan (Growth): +1. Also set up a secondary CTA to join the webinar; measure webinar signups from pricing page.
Maya (Marketing): Cool. Action items: Priya update FAQ by EOD, Ethan set GA + funnel, Devs add hidden field to calculator, Sales confirm routing fields, I'll schedule webinar call. Any issues?
Jamie (Product): Might need to check GDPR for hidden fields in EU. Legal already looped in.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks. Closing notes: We'll reconvene Friday with first 48h metrics. :rocket:
